title: Daliang VN — Industrial electroplating chemicals
hero.h1: Chemicals for durable, bright and compliant metal finishes
hero.lead: Daliang VN supplies pretreatment chemicals, plating additives and passivation — backed by an in-house lab and on-site engineering support.
hero.visual: One line — the right chemical for every tank
about.title: Your chemical partner for metal finishing
about.text: Daliang VN is a chemical plant serving metal finishing in Vietnam: from degreasing, pickling and activation through to zinc, nickel and copper plating additives and trivalent chromium passivates. The catalogue holds over 200 products, backed by an in-house analysis laboratory and engineers who work on your line.
v1.d: Bath analysis and trial formulation before every delivery.
v2.d: Bath operation guidance and plating defect troubleshooting right at your line.
v3.d: Safety data sheets (MSDS) and technical data sheets (TDS) for every product.
